summary: PhoenixOS (PHOS) is the first OS service that can concurrently checkpoint and restore GPU processes, using validated speculation of GPU memory accesses to retrofit CPU-style copy-on-write and on-demand restore techniques for GPUs. Figure 3 shows PHOS's three core components with a numbered control flow: a command-line tool (1) lets users checkpoint, migrate, or restore a GPU process by PID, sending a request over IPC/LFC; inside 'A GPU process,' the PHOS frontend (2), a GPU API interceptor sitting between the app code and the GPU driver, traces GPU read/write sets; the PHOS backend (3) performs the actual checkpoint/restore, combining a pink 'GPU CR' engine with the reused CRIU tool (blue) for CPU process state, drawing from a GPU context pool and writing to a pluggable checkpoint image source (memory, SSD, RDMA, NVM) via intermediate buffers.
summary_zh: 图3展示PHOS三大组件：命令行工具经IPC/LFC与嵌入GPU驱动的前端拦截器通信，追踪读写集，后端结合自研GPU CR引擎与CRIU完成检查点/恢复，支持多种存储后端。
